text:
Jordan Lee: alert — SyncScale disputed March GCP invoice. They say marketplace billed 120 seats but their admin console shows 60. partner asks for credit + pause next invoice.
Priya Singh: can you attach invoice id + s3 link to pdf? need sku and charge amount.
Jordan Lee: invoice INV-GCP-2026-03-8842, sku com.syncscale.pro.monthly, pdf s3://redwood-prod/finance/disputes/syncscale/INV-GCP-2026-03-8842.pdf, billed amount $12,000.
GCP-Partner-Bot: GCP notification: order 2026-03-22-997 delivered meter events with quantity=120, but reseller reported buyer_count=60.
Marco Alvarez: ledger shows billed_qty=120, marketplace_qty=60. looks like double-counting in metering pipeline.
Asha N.: checking event logs — two POST /metering/v1/usage within 7s for same order; retry_id different. our dedupe key wasn't attached for this vendor.
FinanceBot: Audit rule AP-112 flagged duplicate metering events for SyncScale on 2026-03-22. New case RB-9570.
Jordan Lee: partner wants credit and hold on auto-bill. can we pause?
Priya Singh: yes — we should: 1) place temporary hold on auto-invoicing 2) issue credit memo for 60 seats = $6,000 3) fix metering idempotency and deploy 4) notify GCP support.
Marco Alvarez: opening infra bug INFRA-3178: "metering: persist idempotency_key on all incoming meter events". attaching logs and regression test.
Asha N.: GCP support responded (case GCP-44721) — they confirm duplicate delivery due to transient 504 on their side; they won't rebill.
Jordan Lee: accounting needs to approve expedited credit. Ellen / acct-pay, can you ACK?
FinanceBot: Approval request ACK-8620 created and linked to RB-9570.
Priya Singh: drafting partner message: apology, explain we initiated credit CM-2026-03-SYNC-01 for $6,000, hold on next invoice, ETA 3 business days, offer call. posting for review.
Marco Alvarez: INFRA-3178 created and linked to RB-9570 + ACK-8620. starting PR.
Asha N.: place auto-bill hold done.
Jordan Lee: partner replied — thanks, please confirm when credit posts and when billing resumes.
FinanceBot: RB-9570 status updated to in_progress; actions: ["hold_auto_bill","create_credit_memo","deploy_fix"].
Priya Singh: adding to monthly finance risks: "marketplace-metering-duplication".
Jordan Lee: will update partner and close loop when CM posts. thanks team.
